title: NEAR launch coordination
question: I have $10,000 for a NEAR project. Should I run a transparent pilot or a broad launch announcement? Focus on the creator and an independent community reviewer.

world.title: Launch now or earn trust first?
world.description: A hypothetical NEAR creator has $10,000 and must coordinate with an independent community reviewer. Compare a small transparent pilot with a broad announcement. The reviewer decides independently whether to spend time on verification. This is a decision game, not a token-price model.
